about: Trend Pal dances (Trending, Classics, Hip-Hop & Footwork, Country & Line). Add a trend by adding an entry: keys are poses, one every (beats / keys.length) beats. Pose fields (all optional): x,y (body units, y<0 = up), r (tilt deg), sx, sy (squash), k (lean/skew), aL/aR (arm angle deg: 0 down, 90 out to the side, 180 up, negative = across the body), m (idle|walk|hop|happy), f (1 face right, -1 face left), tx (short text pop), star (1 = gold sparkle). ease: smooth|snap|linear. id: 2-13 lowercase letters (shop item dn_<id>). r: c|r|l rarity. k3 = 3D keyframes (see js/pals/dances3d.js pose format), m3 = mirror, free = no coin price, group = trending|classic|hiphop|line, credit = shop credit text. Song audio is never played.
